title: Travel times over the administrative adjacency graph
description: The manifest for road-time.bin: one float32 per edge, in the administrative graph's own edge order. This is what lets the map follow a consolidation scenario built next door rather than a preset frozen at build time — the browser gets a routable national network for 37 KB by reusing the adjacency administrativ already ships. Because the times are positional, the manifest MUST publish a checksum of the pair order so a consumer can refuse a graph it does not recognise instead of pairing every commune with another commune's journey.

pairChecksum.description: Hash of the (a, b) siruta order the times were written against. Required, and the point of the file: without it a rebuilt adjacency silently remaps every journey.

impassableEdges.description: Edges with no measured road time. Left as NaN rather than as a straight-line guess — an unmeasured edge must not become a shortcut.
